brands.title: Parts brands
brands.lead: Genuine parts come from the machine maker. Compatible parts are made by specialist manufacturers to the same specification — usually faster to get and cheaper.
brands.metaDescription: Parts brands we stock — genuine OEM and compatible: {brands}.
brands.genuineBody: Made or approved by the machine manufacturer, under the original part number. Choose these for electronics, timing parts and anything under warranty.
brands.compatibleBody: Made to the OEM dimensions and part number by a specialist (needles, hooks, feed dogs, knives). Same fit, often better availability.
